decisions.decision: Keep the right proof block as a reusable liquid-glass card via a global CSS class instead of Tailwind-only utilities.
decisions.rationale: The requested effect needs pseudo-elements, backdrop-filter, and layered shadows; a shared CSS class is clearer and easier to tune.

decisions.decision: Use Sansation for the right proof headline with white text at 44px and 100% line height.
decisions.rationale: This matches the requested typography and keeps the heading visually dominant over the glass card.

decisions.decision: Preserve the existing advantages section and add the proof section below it as a separate composition block.
decisions.rationale: This keeps the phase-2 advantages work intact while layering the new proof content underneath as requested.

next_action: Resume with $gsd-resume-work and either start Phase 3 discussion or continue the next visual/content refinement outside Phase 2.
context_notes: Working tree is clean. Phase 2 deliverables are committed, and the right proof block now has a liquid-glass treatment, dark overlay, Sansation headline, and simplified inner layout. The last interaction was a pause request after all current UI adjustments were committed.
